Container.Name: omni-mcp
Container.Overview:
Consolidated Model Context Protocol (MCP) gateway. Serves native Rust tools, supervises local MCP servers and proxies remote ones behind a single HTTP endpoint, so AI IDEs need one connection instead of a dozen processes.
SECURITY: this endpoint drives tools that read and write files. It requires a bearer token (OMNI_MCP_TOKEN) and should stay on a trusted network. Code execution and file mutation are disabled unless enabled in omni-mcp.toml.

Config.Name: HTTP MCP Port
Config.Description: HTTP MCP port for IDE connections.

Config.Name: Config File
Config.Description: Path to omni-mcp.toml on the host.

Config.Name: Auth Token
Config.Description: REQUIRED. Bearer token clients must present. Generate one with: head -c 32 /dev/urandom | base64

Config.Name: Workspace
Config.Description: Optional. Files the filesystem tools may reach. List the same path under tools.allowed_roots.

Config.Name: Log Level
Config.Description: Log verbosity: error, warn, info, debug, trace.
